description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Ice 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Chivalry Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Chivalry Mode
description.text: Grants Heroism +1 after casting Shard Striker, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]
